synopsis: ISO 18571 compares measured and simulated time histories using corridor, phase, magnitude and slope sub-scores; the booklet warns that peak-only comparisons can mislead, citing a 0.3% peak difference alongside a 60.4% time-history error [f15331, f15332, f15335]. An IDIADA–MathWorks demonstration recorded on 14 April 2026 correlated closed-loop virtual AEB against production-vehicle proving-ground tests using ISO 18571, providing an on-road precedent rather than direct heavy off-road validation [f1269]. The glossary reports that Euro NCAP virtual testing requires qualification against physical tests using an ISO score and defined KPIs, and recommends this kind of metric for correlation testing [f15333, f15341]. ISO 16290:2013 standardizes the one-to-nine TRL scale and assessment criteria for space systems; the booklet uses TRLs only for critical-technology maturity, while South African mining's MOSH regime uses TRL4 and TRL7 gates [f9512, f14684, f14686, f15338, f15337]. ISO 25119 covers functional safety for agricultural control systems and may apply to a heavy off-road program by contract, but its fit, editions, application dates and simulation provisions were not verified, so its inclusion is not evidence of an established acceptance route [f15339, f15343, f12054, f4335, f7741].
